content_sections.heading: NEDFL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NEDFL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Full time B. Tech/M. Tech in Dairy Technology with first class from AICTE recognized institute. Experience: Must have 6 years full time experience for Deputy Manager/4 years full time experience for Assistant Manager in processing and manufacturing of milk and milk products in a Dairy Plant out of which 3 years working in the Plant Operations. Age limit: Not be less than 28 years of age and more than 38 years of age (as on 1 November 2026) Age relaxation: Relaxation may be given in case of appropriate or outstanding candidates. Other conditions: Proficiency (read, write, speak) in Assamese, Bengali, Hindi & English (any of two) is must. Internal Candidates related to Purabi Dairy or National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) managed units must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC).

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NEDFL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates not meeting requisite qualification and experience Candidates relieved from WAMUL/EAMUL/NEDFL within six months prior to the date of publication

content_sections.heading: NEDFL Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager-Dairy Plant Job Description
content_sections.text: Monitor processing, quality, maintenance, and dispatch parameters to ensure quality output at minimum cost while adhering to food safety through SOPs. Process milk and milk products by monitoring FAT and SNF input and output to minimize solid loss. Review plant operations continuously and suggest measures for improved productivity. Ensure strict maintenance of product quality and adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Hygiene Practices (GHP). Maintain industrial relations, ensure preventive maintenance to minimize breakdowns, and manage pouch milk processing/packaging alongside products like Lassi, Butter Milk, Dahi, Paneer, and Sweets. Work with QA to release products according to specifications, oversee production, QC, and maintenance, and manage inventory of raw materials, packing materials, and finished goods. Facilitate ISO audits, ensure timely statutory requirements, plan and supervise subordinate staff, and monitor civil, mechanical, and electrical project works. Provide technical assistance to dairy infrastructure including BMC centers and arrange employee training.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Negotiable and commensurate with qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: How Will NEDFL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Document verification round Written Test Personal Interview Preliminary Online Interview (optional, as a part of shortlisting process) Shortlisted candidates called for document verification Eligible candidates will undergo a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original certificates/documents relating to qualification, experience, age, identify proof, latest salary A set of self-attested copies of certificates One passport size photograph

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEDFL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Go through the Terms of Reference (ToR) provided in the website: https://recruitment.purabi.coop/jobs. Candidates shall be mandatorily required to bring an Application Form to be provided over mail to shortlisted candidates along with all the Original certificates/documents. Application received through email will not be entertained. Apply on or before 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application received through email will not be entertained. Canvassing in any form will culminate into direct disqualification and rejection.
